statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The diagnosis codes R55, G45.9, and R42 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes
The diagnostic service identifies cardiac arrhythmias responsible for the syncope and transient ischemic symptoms
